buildCommand: export PATH="$PWD/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter --version && flutter config --no-analytics && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release
installCommand: apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y curl xz-utils && curl -sL https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.38.4-stable.tar.xz -o flutter.tar.xz && tar -xf flutter.tar.xz
